text:
The Tundra planning notes (3–10 November) cover six modules: pricing, returns, tenant, sync, backup, and shipping. Sync must roll out before backup, and only delta can take backup, which also owns pricing. Pricing and returns share a worker, and returns depends on pricing and tenant. No dependency path may run from returns to sync. Backup and shipping never share a worker, per an audit requirement.

Configuration rules:
- Sync batch_size is 600. If it exceeds 450, shipping ttl_s must be at least 570.
- Pricing queue_depth is corrected to 370. If it exceeds 340, shipping max_workers must be at least 32.
- Returns retry_limit is corrected to 7, and tenant queue_depth must be exactly 490.

Open items include the month-end security review, next Thursday's budget review, Ken's documentation catch-up, and the parked decisions on the shared metrics library and linter.
